subject: Convergence playbook: QBR deliverables & exec asks
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-11T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Convergence playbook: QBR deliverables & exec asks

Morning all —

Thanks for joining the sync this morning. Capturing the follow-ups we promised to lock before Friday so the execs have a clean view for the QBR deck. Please review and confirm owners/ETA inline.

High-level asks (from today):
- Executive one-pager: consolidate top 3 product wins + ask (owner: Marissa) — deliver draft by Thu EOD.
- Performance delta analysis: quantify 95p latency improvements after caching changes (owner: Vivek) — numbers + short slide by Thu noon.
- Risk exceptions: rollup of outstanding infra exceptions that need exec signoff (owner: Karthik & Aditya) — submit list + mitigation by Thu EOD.
- Customer call summary: finalize Acme Health ask language for the deck (owner: Marissa) — confirm wording by Fri 10am.

Attachments: I uploaded a quick tracker to keep this tight: qbr_prep_tracker.xlsx (see sheet "owners"). I'll update as items close.

Primary asks: if you cannot hit the ETA, reply with a new date within 24 hours so we can escalate.

Thanks —
Karthik
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-11T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Convergence playbook: QBR deliverables & exec asks

On Tue, Jun 11, 2028 at 09:02 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Morning all —
> 
> Thanks for joining the sync this morning. Capturing the follow-ups we promised to lock before Friday so the execs have a clean view for the QBR deck. Please review and confirm owners/ETA inline.

Thanks Karthik — adding status from my side below.

1) Executive one-pager (owner: me) — Draft in progress. Will include: top 3 wins, customer highlight (Acme Health), three asks (capacity commit, extended pilot, success metrics). Draft uploaded to the tracker; aiming for Thu 5pm PT.

2) Customer ask language (Acme) — Proposed wording in row 12 of tracker. Laura S (cc) can you confirm the phrasing is accurate for your procurement team? If yes, I will lock it and put it into the slide.

3) Dependencies — I need a short blurb from Aditya on procurement timing (are they OK with the timeline for pilot extension?) and from Vivek on whether the perf numbers will be safe to present (i.e., production vs. staging differences).

Attachments: [Attachment: qbr_prep_tracker.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)]

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@acmehealth.com>, Dan Levin <dan.levin@procurecorp.com>
Date: 2028-06-11T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Convergence playbook: QBR deliverables & exec asks

Marissa / team —

Quick clarifications from product marketing and compliance:
- For the executive pager, please include an "impact" line (revenue/efficiency estimate) under each win. I added suggested phrasing in the tracker comments.
- Security evidence: I'm attaching the index of security artifacts we can point to in the QBR (SOC2 scope, retention policy, audit cadence). Use this doc to fill the "compliance" row in the slide.
- Procurement timing: Dan (ProcureCorp) — copying you so procurement has visibility on the ask language; can you advise if Acme's proposed pilot extension is procurement-ready?

Attachments: [Attachment: security-evidence-index.pdf (document, 210KB)]

Laura Bennett
Sr. Product Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-11T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Convergence playbook: QBR deliverables & exec asks

Quick update —
- Performance delta: final numbers look good. 95p latency improved ~18% after prefix/KV caching in prod (validated on 2028-06-08 canary run). I will push the slide to the drive by Thu 11am.
- Runbook: updated the incident runbook to call out the fallback model variant; link to the runbook is here: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/open?id=runbook-234
- No blocking infra exceptions remain that would change the exec recommendation; Karthik/Aditya, if you still have items, flag them and I will annotate the risk slide.

Vivek
Engineering Lead, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dan Levin <dan.levin@procurecorp.com>
Date: 2028-06-11T12:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Convergence playbook: QBR deliverables & exec asks

Marissa / Karthik —

Thanks for pulling this together. The draft language in the tracker looks good from our side — one small edit on the pilot ask (we need a 60- rather than 90-day extension). Otherwise green to proceed.

Would either of you be available for a 15-min alignment call tomorrow (Thu) at 10:30am PT to confirm final phrasing? If so, I can send a calendar invite.

Best,
Laura Simmons
VP, Digital Transformation
Acme Health

Subject: Re: Acme pilot extension — procurement note
To: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Laura — quick note: the shorter pilot simplifies procurement; we can fast-track contract addendum if both parties sign off by Friday. I'll coordinate with Aditya on the SOW addendum language.
